sloka: अथ वर्ष सहस्रेण योक्त्र सर्प शिरांसि च ।वमन्तो अति विषम् तत्र ददंशुर् दशनैः शिलाः ॥१-४५-१९॥
transliteration: atha varṣa sahasreṇa yoktra sarpa śirāṁsi ca ।vamanto ati viṣam tatra dadaṁśur daśanaiḥ śilāḥ ॥1-45-19॥

translations.english: After a thousand years, the hoods of the snake made as rope vomitted venom and started biting the rocks of the Mandara mountain with their teeth.
